[Chapter 4: Airframe Structural Fasteners & Torque Limits (Model 737-800) — 4.1 Standard Maintenance Practices and Hydraulic System Ratings] Chapter 4: Airframe Structural Fasteners & Torque Limits (Model 737-800)
4.1 Standard Maintenance Practices and Hydraulic System Ratings
All primary structural fasteners on the Model 737-800 airframe must be tightened using a calibrated torque wrench inspected within the last 90 days. The primary hydraulic flight control system operates at a nominal pressure of 3,000 PSI with a thermal relief valve cracking pressure of 3,750 PSI. Never reuse self-locking nuts once removal torque drops below the minimum prevailing torque threshold.

[Chapter 9: Engine Starting & Ignition Control Systems (Model 737-800) — 9.4 Engine Starter Relay Control Wiring and Valve Interlock] Chapter 9: Engine Starting & Ignition Control Systems (Model 737-800)
9.4 Engine Starter Relay Control Wiring and Valve Interlock
When the start switch is placed in the GND position on the Model 737-800 overhead panel, current flows through the N2 RPM cutout switch to energize the starter relay coil and open the pneumatic starter shutoff valve.
